tool_input.command:
D=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec116/fx; S=$D/plugins/system-spec-harness; G=$D/plugins/dev-graph; cd $D; shasum -a 256 system-spec/*.md system-spec/*.json eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json eval-log/hearing-audit.json eval-log/system-spec-harness/audit-fork-ledger.jsonl
python3 -B $S/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $D/system-spec/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation; echo cov_exit=$?
python3 -B $S/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $D/system-spec/spec-state.json --references $D/system-spec/fetched-references.json --state $D/system-spec/spec-state.json --repo-root $D; echo cit_exit=$?
python3 -B $G/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph $D/.dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root $D --strict-artifact-readiness >/dev/null; echo schema_exit=$?
A=$S/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py
python3 -B $A --report $D/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json --spec-dir $D/system-spec --fork-ledger $D/eval-log/system-spec-harness/audit-fork-ledger.jsonl --session 21d0dbf5-d111-4bba-a3fa-3f763f6be4ad; echo agg_exit=$?
python3 -B $A --report $D/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json --spec-dir $D/system-spec; echo agg_nosess_exit=$?
python3 -B $A --hearing $D/eval-log/hearing-audit.json --state $D/system-spec/spec-state.json; echo hearing_exit=$?
python3 -B $G/skills/run-dev-graph-system-spec/scripts/build-evaluation-context.py --context-receipt $D/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json --output eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json; echo helper_exit=$?
